title: Nano Nuclear Energy Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-06
summary: Nano Nuclear Energy Inc. (ticker: NNE, Nasdaq-listed) filed an 8-K on April 6, 2026 disclosing that on April 2, 2026, its partner The Grainger College of Engineering at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign submitted a Construction Permit Application to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission for the KRONOS MMR nuclear micro-reactor deployment. This is a routine SEC disclosure under Item 8.01 (Other Events) and does not discuss market structure or macro catalysts.
